name: Waldbad Cafe
kurzbeschreibung: Former café of the Waldbad on the outskirts of Ischgl in the Paznaun Valley (Landeck district), permanently closed since autumn 2022.
beschreibung:
The Waldbad Café was part of the Waldbad on the outskirts of Ischgl in the Paznaun Valley, in the Landeck district. The outdoor pool was operated by Silvrettaseilbahn AG and was regarded as an adventure and relaxation pool against the backdrop of the Silvretta. From the café on the sun terrace, guests had a view over the entire Waldbad complex.

With the opening of the new Silvretta Therme in December 2022, the operation of the Waldbad came to an end. As early as September 2022, the pool had been permanently closed after the summer season, as operating two pools in parallel was not economically justifiable. A subsequent use of the area remained open at first. The Waldbad Café is therefore no longer in operation.
